description: Figure: hydrophobic patch areas and their structural location in LNPK vs RING domains
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, numpy as np
R=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(module='LNPK ZnF\n(AF, 265-315)', n=10, area=859, where='around knuckle 2 /\nlunapark motif L304-K309'),
 dict(module='RNF4 RING\n(4AP4, 131-185)', n=10, area=844, where='Zn-loop 1 (P137,I138,M140)\n= measured E2 interface'),
 dict(module='c-CBL RING\n(1FBV, 378-425)', n=6, area=536, where='Zn-loop 1 (F378,L380,I383)'),
 dict(module='TFIIS Zn ribbon\n(1TFI, 1-50)', n=2, area=590, where='P33,M34'),
])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
cols=['#1f77b4','#d62728','#d62728','#1f77b4']
ax[0].bar(R.module,R.area,color=cols); ax[0].set_ylabel('largest contiguous exposed\nhydrophobic patch (A$^2$)')
ax[0].tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1000)
for i,v in enumerate(R.area): ax[0].text(i,v+15,f"{int(v)}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_title('LNPK does present an exposed hydrophobic patch\nof RING-comparable area (Shrake-Rupley, rel SASA > 0.25)',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax[1].axis('off')
ax[1].text(0,1,
 "Where the patch sits is what differs\n\n"
 "RNF4   V134 P137 I138 M140 Y143 V147 L152 I153 V161 P178\n"
 "       4/10 are measured E2 contacts in 4AP4 (P137, I138,\n"
 "       M140, P178); the patch IS the E2 site.\n\n"
 "LNPK   Y293 I294 A295 A299 Y300 F302 F303 L304 P306 A307\n"
 "       sits around knuckle 2 and the lunapark motif\n"
 "       (L304-N305-P306-A307-R308-K309), with no second\n"
 "       zinc site, no central helix and no linchpin register.\n"
 "       PMID 30498943 assigns this exact motif to\n"
 "       homo-oligomerisation of Lnp.\n\n"
 "Consequence for the seed hypothesis: the sub-claim that\n"
 "LNPK 'lacks the E2-binding hydrophobic residues' is not\n"
 "supported as literally worded. The decisive evidence is the\n"
 "missing second zinc site, the missing central helix and the\n"
 "Foldseek fold assignment.",
 va='top',ha='left',fontsize=9.3,family='monospace')
plt.suptitle('Hydrophobic-surface test: presence of a patch does not make LNPK a RING',fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
